name: JumpCloud
summary: JumpCloud sells MFA as a standalone product at $3 per user per month billed annually, or $4 billed monthly. Conditional Access is a separate $3 line item, so risk-style rules add to the MFA price.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: JumpCloud supports push MFA through JumpCloud Protect, TOTP codes, and WebAuthn security keys such as YubiKey and Titan.
JumpCloud describes conditional access covering network, device and risk, and gives the example of restricting access when users are off a trusted network or a device falls out of compliance.
Admins set a global enrollment grace period and can require enrollment of one primary MFA factor, after which enrollment is mandatory before access is granted.
Suspended users remain billable at the normal rate.
